In honor of the announcement of the game, the first part of the game "Hentai Chicks" has been updated:
▶ 37% DISCOUNT for two weeks
▶ Implemented animations of puzzle tiles during fusion and autoresolution
▶ Correctly placed tiles can no longer be moved
▶ Added sound for correct positioning of any puzzle tiles
▶ Fixed the problem of destruction of the logic of the current puzzle when pressing the "Reset" button multiple times
▶ Auto-solving the puzzle is now on the "E" button, and not on the "F" as it was before
▶ Minor edits.

notes.title: Underwear Day
notes.notes:
Underwear Day (unofficial) was held on 5 August.
Originally from the USA, the holiday was born in 2013 and hosted a marathon in Times Square in New York with more than 800 participants, all in their underwear, in hopes of breaking the Guinness World Record for the number of people gathered in one place in underwear. Believe it or not, it wasn't enough to break the record. But thanks to this event, a new wonderful holiday was born.

And today a micro-update was introduced for the game that removes unnecessary screen resolutions when starting the game. The game supports any screen resolution by default, only 16: 9 formats are left.
